parameters.name: feature_x
parameters.description: Index of the first feature to use (X axis)

parameters.name: feature_y
parameters.description: Index of the second feature to use (Y axis)

parameters.name: margin_type
parameters.description: Type of SVM: Hard Margin enforces zero misclassifications (requires separable data), Soft Margin allows some 'slack' via the C parameter.

parameters.name: C
parameters.description: Regularization parameter (only used for Soft Margin). Lower values widen the margin; higher values enforce correct classification more strictly.
